market.headline: Tech is gapping lower again before the open, with QQQ at 617.94 (-3.2%) and SPY at 704.24 (-2.0%), as the AI sell-off spreads back from Asia and lenders grow pickier about funding the AI build-out. GDP and PCE inflation come out at 08:30.
watch: 08:30 GDP second estimate and October PCE inflation. A hot PCE hurts tech most. The 10-year yield has already eased to 4.92 from 5.12.
QQQ 606.23 (20-day low) and 631.15 (yesterday's low). SPY 686.75 (20-day low).
VIX at 26.62 and rising from 22.91 five sessions ago: expect wide swings all day, the first hour especially.
market.if_then: If QQQ breaks 606.23 (its 20-day low), then buy nothing and cut AI-chip positions into any bounce. If QQQ gets back above 631.15 (yesterday's low), then the conditional buys below (AVGO, NVDA, ORCL) are allowed.

stocks.headline: Down 6.2% premarket to 145.72 after Huang's political rescue and new worries about AI debt.
stocks.why: The business is not the problem. Sales are up 106% and growing faster, forecasts are up 28% in 90 days, and the stock trades at 9× next year's profit. The selling comes from two things. Huang's return under White House pressure brings scrutiny from both parties. And lenders are getting pickier about the bonds that pay for Big Tech's AI spending, and that spending is Nvidia's revenue. NVDA sets the tone for AMD, MU, AVGO, TSM, ARM, SMCI and CRWV, so its first hour tells you how the whole group trades today.

long_term.reason: The growth and the cheap valuation are real, but the governance and political risk around Huang is not settled. Owners keep their shares. New money waits for the scandal to cool.

stocks.what_would_change_it: If big customers say they are cutting AI spending because debt is harder to raise, the growth story breaks and the stance goes to Wait.
stocks.action: Don't buy the open. Add only if it climbs back above 150.50 after the first hour.

levels.means: Above = buyers are absorbing the gap and a small add is fine. Below = selling is still in control, so do nothing.
52-week low. Above = the long-term floor holds. Below = the sell-off has turned into a full reset and the Hold needs a fresh look.

stocks.if_then: If it trades below 145.72 in the first hour and stays there, then cancel any add for today.

stocks.headline: Down 4.9% premarket to 286.30, below the house buy line of 288.79 and the 52-week low of 288.98.
stocks.why: This is the stock the house wanted to buy at this price. Sales are up 86% and speeding up, there is $179.2B of contracted backlog, and it trades at 15.5× forward profit. The risks are $59.4B of long-term debt, profit growing slower than sales, and earnings on Dec 9 with a typical move of 11%. A fresh 52-week low on market fear, with no company news, is the setup a long-term buyer waits for. Buy in pieces and don't catch it in one go.

long_term.reason: Fast growth, a huge backlog and a fair price. It is now inside the house buy zone below 288.79.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A Dec 9 report showing the backlog slipping or margins squeezed further would end the Buy case.
stocks.action: Don't buy the open. Buy a first half-position only if it trades back above 288.98 after the first hour, and keep the rest for after the Dec 9 report.

levels.means: Above = the break of the 52-week low failed, so buy the first half. Below = new lows, so wait.
Yesterday's low. Above = a real recovery that confirms the buy. Below = still under pressure.

stocks.if_then: If QQQ breaks 606.23, then skip the buy today even if AVGO reclaims 288.98.

stocks.headline: Down 6.0% premarket to 102.90, close to its 52-week low of 100.25, with earnings due Dec 14.
stocks.why: The numbers say cheap growth. There is $664.0B of contracted backlog, sales are up 30% and speeding up, it has beaten forecasts 4 quarters running, and it trades at 9.9× forward profit. The worry hitting it is today's news: debt markets are tightening for AI build-outs, and Oracle's backlog only turns into profit if it can keep paying for data centres. A rise in the cost of that money would hurt its margins first.

long_term.reason: The house says Buy now. The backlog and the valuation justify it, but the AI-debt fear makes the timing hard.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A Dec 14 report that cuts the outlook or shows funding trouble for its data centres would turn the stance to Wait.
stocks.action: Don't buy the gap. Buy only if it climbs back to 108.24 (yesterday's low), which shows buyers taking control.

levels.means: 52-week low. Above = the floor holds. Below = no buying until after the Dec 14 report.
Yesterday's low. Above = buy. Below = the gap is still being sold.

stocks.if_then: If it trades at or below 100.25, then don't buy at all before earnings.
